landmarks.name: Palm Cove Beach
landmarks.fact: Palm Cove Beach is famous for its idyllic palm-lined shoreline and relaxed tropical atmosphere near Cairns, Queensland.

landmarks.name: Palm Cove Esplanade
landmarks.fact: This seaside street is famous for its ancient Melaleuca paperbark trees shading beachfront cafes and resorts.

landmarks.name: Palm Cove Jetty
landmarks.fact: This iconic pier is a popular local fishing spot offering scenic views across the Coral Sea.

landmarks.name: Double Island
landmarks.fact: Located just off Palm Cove, this private island is a historic retreat visible along the tropical horizon.
